title: Noor and the Locker
author: August Nystrom
blurb: Rosalind Crane, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
